case.name: NIST CFReDS Hacking Case
case.case_summary: The registry names Greg Schardt as the registered owner, and the account Mr. Evil has the only logon count above 0, which is 15. Uninstall records name Cain & Abel, Look@LAN, Network Stumbler, Ethereal, WinPcap, 123 Write All Stored Passwords and Anonymizer Bar. On 2004-08-27, after a logon for Mr. Evil at 15:08:23 UTC, prefetch times show NETSTUMBLER.EXE at 15:12:35 UTC and ETHEREAL.EXE at 15:34:54 UTC. The file interception in the Mr. Evil profile holds HTTP requests to mobile.msn.com and Passport hosts from a client with a Windows CE User-Agent. The files lalsetup250.exe, netstumblerinstaller_0_4_0.exe, WinPcap_3_01_a.exe and ethereal-setup-0.10.6.exe went to the Recycle Bin, but the file system does not mark them deleted. I infer, with moderate confidence, that the person who used the account Mr. Evil set up wireless capture tools and used the name Greg Schardt.
